nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: Thank you for feeding me. You’re such a good person!

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: I think we’re good friends now. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: All right. Have a nice day. I hope that oneday in the future, you’ll pet me.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: Please allow me to recommend my favorite snack to you: freeze-dried chicken breast! It’s crispy and fragrant, and it can make every cat rush toward you like a rocket.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: You’re my friend, and I want to treat you to freeze-dried chicken breast. But the problem right now is… the snack cabinet is empty.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: But if you can help me fill the snack cabinet, we’ll be able to enjoy snacks together.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: First, we need to analyze why the snack cabinet is empty: my owner lost her job, so she cut the budget.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: If we can help her find a job, she’ll buy new snacks again!

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: So, dear friend, if you know of any software development job openings, please recommend them to my owner. You can contact her on this page.

options.label: Of course, I’d be happy to help.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: It’s okay. Since we’re friends, when I get new freeze-dried treats in the future, I’ll share them with you.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: Thank you so much! When I get new freeze-dried treats in the future, I’ll share them with you.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: By the way, let’s keep this as a secret between the two of us. She didn’t like the mouse I gave her last time, so I hope she’ll like this gift.

nodes.speaker: Cat
nodes.text: Goodbye, dear friend. Have a nice day.
